instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)
applicationNote: Mostly NOT yet in application. Article 71 sets three dates: Chapter IV (Articles 35 to 51) applies from 11 June 2026, Article 14 from 11 September 2026, and the Regulation as a whole from 11 December 2027. Write about the main obligations in the future tense — as at 2026-08-15 only Chapter IV has started to apply.
note: 71 Articles and 8 Annexes — verified against the EUR-Lex consolidated DOM on 2026-08-15. Application dates read directly from Article 71 and carried in applicationNote, because quoting a not-yet-applicable obligation in the present tense is the specific way this instrument misleads. EUR-Lex consolidated texts omit the preamble, so no recitals are present. Text is reused from EUR-Lex under CC BY 4.0 (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU).
